nodes.text: 1  Oxygen-poor blood from the body fills the right atrium
2  It passes the tricuspid valve, and the right ventricle pumps it to the lungs
3  Oxygen-rich blood returns from the lungs to the left atrium
4  It passes the mitral valve, and the left ventricle pumps it into the aorta

widgets.text: A real adult heart, about the size of a fist, built from anatomical scans. It beats 72 times a minute. Blue is oxygen-poor blood, red is oxygen-rich. Turn on X-ray or cut it open to watch the blood move inside.
